meta.title: Inductance Converter — Convert Henry and More
meta.description: Free inductance converter for 4+ units including Henry, Millihenry, Microhenry. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Henry, millihenry, microhenry. Convert between 4 inductance units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for inductance in this tool is **H**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most inductance conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |

content.use_cases:
- Power supply sizing and load calculations.

- Solar and renewable system sizing.
- Lab and bench-test electrical measurements.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this inductance converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Henry (H), Millihenry (mH), Microhenry (µH), Nanohenry (nH).
